map.射频紧肤效果评估 使用指南: Radiofrequency Tightening Effect Evaluation User Guide
map.射频紧肤效果评估器，输入真皮目标温度与维持时间评估胶原收缩与紧肤效果，辅助射频参: The radiofrequency tightening effect evaluator takes a target dermal temperature and hold time to assess collagen contraction and tightening, supporting radiofrequency parameter setup.
map.胶原收缩率按真皮温度分段；收缩率 = min(分段值 × 时间因子, 55%)；: Contraction rate is tiered by dermal temperature; contraction = min(tier value × time factor, 55%); time factor = min(1 + 0.3 × ln(time), 1.8)
map.收缩率分段：<45 ℃ 为 0；45–55 ℃ 为 (T − 45)/10 ×: Contraction rate is tiered: <45 °C gives 0; 45–55 °C gives (T − 45)/10 × 10; 55–60 °C gives 10 + (T − 55)/5 × 10; 60–70 °C gives 20 + (T − 60)/10 × 25; 70–75 °C gives 45 + (T − 70)/5 × 5; ≥75 °C caps at 50%. Effect grading: <45 none, <55 slight, <65 good, <75 notable, ≥75 risk zone. Used to quantify collagen contraction and tightening from radiofrequency or heat.

map.风险识别：长时间同一处停留的烫伤风险。: Risk awareness: burns from lingering in one area too long.
map.疗效复盘：按温度时间记录判断是否达到刺激窗。: Efficacy review: use temperature and time logs to judge whether the therapeutic window was reached.
